name: existing-website-transformation
title: Existing Website Transformation
description: Analyse an existing website first, then improve it incrementally without blindly rebuilding everything.
when_to_use: The client already has a site (URL, files or repository) and wants it better rather than replaced.
instructions: Start from the imported baseline: inventory what exists (pages, URLs, content, brand assets, functionality) before proposing changes.
Classify every element as keep / improve / replace, with the reason; default to keep.
Preserve URLs, valuable copy, SEO equity and working functionality unless the brief explicitly asks otherwise.
Change only what the improvement plan specifies and record every change.
